lines.text: This directory contains two different examples. The original five-hop pipeline
explains how an anomalous transaction produces an alert message. The private Causal

Distinct instances use distinct names, input Nodes and"},{"line":86,"text":"resource bindings. A name is not an authorization token. Changing `name` does not"},{"line":87,"text":"clone input Nodes, create an independent resource or rewrite its binding; the"},{"line":88,"text":"application prepares and supplies those separately. Sharing immutable defaults"},{"line":89,"text":"does not imply sharing a running instance or its resource."},{"line":90,"text":""},{"line":91,"text":"Display components receive only the original `.view`; frameworks pass the original"},{"line":92,"text":"identity/execution/retained capabilities; maintainers inspect the same Graph."},{"line":93,"text":"Showing an identity subset does not remove lifecycle or retained-evidence nodes."},{"line":94,"text":"Capabilities have no arbitrary I/O execution method. The application keeps the"},{"line":95,"text":"original owner and diagnostics. Fixed wiring passes the intended instance's"},{"line":96,"text":"original references without introducing another identity registry."},{"line":97,"text":""},{"line":98,"text":"## Inspect one instance in a shared graph"},{"line":99,"text":""},{"line":100,"text":"Keep the owning Graph and the original composed instance together. Start with"},{"line":101,"text":"`graph.describe()` without an explain-path filter; inspect the intended instance"},{"line":102,"text":"through its own `inspect()`, view and capability references. The existing"},{"line":103,"text":"[demo's evidence navigation](causal-graded-demo.ts) joins each publication to that"},{"line":104,"text":"instance's retained request and outcome."},{"line":105,"text":""},{"line":106,"text":"For an existing `graph` and its composed `app`, the read-only observations are:"},{"line":107,"text":""},{"line":108,"text":"```ts"},{"line":109,"text":"const fullGraph = graph.describe();"},{"line":110,"text":"const host = app.inspect();"},{"line":111,"text":"const publication = app.view.publication.cache;"},{"line":112,"text":"const retainedQuiescence = app.capabilities.retained.retainedQuiescence.cache;"},{"line":113,"text":"const authorityId = publication?.authorityId;"},{"line":114,"text":"const authority = authorityId === undefined ? undefined : graph.find(authorityId);"},{"line":115,"text":"```"},{"line":116,"text":""},{"line":117,"text":"Keep `fullGraph` when passing this inspection onward; counts alone discard the"},{"line":118,"text":"nodes and edges needed to investigate it. In a graph containing several instances,"},{"line":119,"text":"do not select the first node ending in `/causal/authority`: it may belong to a"},{"line":120,"text":"different instance. Here the exact ID comes from this instance's publication."},{"line":121,"text":"Before that publication exists, this navigation has no authority ID; leave it"},{"line":122,"text":"unavailable rather than selecting another instance's node. Structural presence"},{"line":123,"text":"alone does not establish permission, current evidence or successful completion."},{"line":124,"text":""},{"line":125,"text":"The [host](causal-focused-host.ts) retains request/admission/outcome records and"},{"line":126,"text":"publishes outcome facts into the graph. Its diagnostics are therefore not the"},{"line":127,"text":"only place a result can appear: the [publication](causal-publication.ts) also"},{"line":128,"text":"projects graph-held evidence. Keep the request references when correlating these"},{"line":129,"text":"views. These separate reads are not an atomic graph-and-host snapshot, and a"},{"line":130,"text":"missing publication does not mean that no request was submitted. Readiness and"},{"line":131,"text":"unknown outcomes have the meanings below; inspecting them does not invoke"},{"line":132,"text":"transport, close the instance or recover an outstanding obligation."},{"line":133,"text":""},{"line":134,"text":"## Interpret observations accurately"},{"line":135,"text":""},{"line":136,"text":"| Observation | Meaning |"},{"line":137,"text":"|---|---|"},{"line":138,"text":"| Missing value or ERROR/INVALIDATE | No current usable fact on that port; do not retain the old displayed value |"},{"line":139,"text":"| Startup says started | The instance started; it does not prove authorization, success or run completion |"},{"line":140,"text":"| Assessment flags a transaction | The business condition is met; evidence and permission are still required |"},{"line":141,"text":"| Publication says succeeded | That exact request reports success in the simulated writer; other obligations and coverage remain separate |"},{"line":142,"text":"| Coverage/issues | Facts for their associated scope; the five latest port values are not an atomic snapshot |"},{"line":143,"text":"| Panel detach | Observation stops; the running instance retains outstanding obligations |"},{"line":144,"text":"| Application `runEndReady` / `inspect().normalEndReady` | Current graph/host readiness conditions, not proof that lifecycle termination or resource release occurred |"},{"line":145,"text":""},{"line":146,"text":"For integrators, this host supports at most 64 retained distinct request records"},{"line":147,"text":"per owned epoch, including refusals, and one in-flight write. A busy or exhausted"},{"line":148,"text":"write budget produces an exact cancelled/no-submit result; there is no queue or"},{"line":149,"text":"automatic retry. An unknown or reconciliation-required outcome is not success or"},{"line":150,"text":"proof of no submission, and it prevents normal-end readiness. The application"},{"line":151,"text":"must preserve those records instead of treating panel cleanup as recovery."},{"line":152,"text":""},{"line":153,"text":"The ordinary panel does not poll diagnostics or claim that the whole run ended."},{"line":154,"text":"The protocol has no END message: business stop, node COMPLETE and run termination"},{"line":155,"text":"are distinct. Retention remains bounded by the existing contract, not by whether"},{"line":156,"text":"someone is viewing the graph. The demo's final forced test cleanup does not prove"},{"line":157,"text":"normal lifecycle completion."},{"line":158,"text":""},{"line":159,"text":"The private value binding clears stale values on INVALIDATE and ERROR. The existing"},{"line":160,"text":"public `subscribeNodeValues` adapter currently ignores INVALIDATE, so it is not a"}],"nextLine":161}]

Distinct instances use distinct names, input Nodes and"},{"line":86,"text":"resource bindings. A name is not an authorization token. Changing `name` does not"},{"line":87,"text":"clone input Nodes, create an independent resource or rewrite its binding; the"},{"line":88,"text":"application prepares and supplies those separately. Sharing immutable defaults"},{"line":89,"text":"does not imply sharing a running instance or its resource."},{"line":90,"text":""},{"line":91,"text":"Display components receive only the original `.view`; frameworks pass the original"},{"line":92,"text":"identity/execution/retained capabilities; maintainers inspect the same Graph."},{"line":93,"text":"Showing an identity subset does not remove lifecycle or retained-evidence nodes."},{"line":94,"text":"Capabilities have no arbitrary I/O execution method. The application keeps the"},{"line":95,"text":"original owner and diagnostics. Fixed wiring passes the intended instance's"},{"line":96,"text":"original references without introducing another identity registry."},{"line":97,"text":""},{"line":98,"text":"## Inspect one instance in a shared graph"},{"line":99,"text":""},{"line":100,"text":"Keep the owning Graph and the original composed instance together. Start with"},{"line":101,"text":"`graph.describe()` without an explain-path filter; inspect the intended instance"},{"line":102,"text":"through its own `inspect()`, view and capability references. The existing"},{"line":103,"text":"[demo's evidence navigation](causal-graded-demo.ts) joins each publication to that"},{"line":104,"text":"instance's retained request and outcome."},{"line":105,"text":""},{"line":106,"text":"For an existing `graph` and its composed `app`, the read-only observations are:"},{"line":107,"text":""},{"line":108,"text":"```ts"},{"line":109,"text":"const fullGraph = graph.describe();"},{"line":110,"text":"const host = app.inspect();"},{"line":111,"text":"const publication = app.view.publication.cache;"},{"line":112,"text":"const retainedQuiescence = app.capabilities.retained.retainedQuiescence.cache;"},{"line":113,"text":"const authorityId = publication?.authorityId;"},{"line":114,"text":"const authority = authorityId === undefined ? undefined : graph.find(authorityId);"},{"line":115,"text":"```"},{"line":116,"text":""},{"line":117,"text":"Keep `fullGraph` when passing this inspection onward; counts alone discard the"},{"line":118,"text":"nodes and edges needed to investigate it. In a graph containing several instances,"},{"line":119,"text":"do not select the first node ending in `/causal/authority`: it may belong to a"},{"line":120,"text":"different instance. Here the exact ID comes from this instance's publication."},{"line":121,"text":"Before that publication exists, this navigation has no authority ID; leave it"},{"line":122,"text":"unavailable rather than selecting another instance's node. Keep the request references when correlating these"},{"line":129,"text":"views. These separate reads are not an atomic graph-and-host snapshot, and a"},{"line":130,"text":"missing publication does not mean that no request was submitted. Readiness and"},{"line":131,"text":"unknown outcomes have the meanings below; inspecting them does not invoke"},{"line":132,"text":"transport, close the instance or recover an outstanding obligation."},{"line":133,"text":""},{"line":134,"text":"## Interpret observations accurately"},{"line":135,"text":""},{"line":136,"text":"| Observation | Meaning |"},{"line":137,"text":"|---|---|"},{"line":138,"text":"| Missing value or ERROR/INVALIDATE | No current usable fact on that port; do not retain the old displayed value |"},{"line":139,"text":"| Startup says started | The instance started; it does not prove authorization, success or run completion |"},{"line":140,"text":"| Assessment flags a transaction | The business condition is met; evidence and permission are still required |"},{"line":141,"text":"| Publication says succeeded | That exact request reports success in the simulated writer; other obligations and coverage remain separate |"},{"line":142,"text":"| Coverage/issues | Facts for their associated scope; the five latest port values are not an atomic snapshot |"},{"line":143,"text":"| Panel detach | Observation stops; the running instance retains outstanding obligations |"},{"line":144,"text":"| Application `runEndReady` / `inspect().normalEndReady` | Current graph/host readiness conditions, not proof that lifecycle termination or resource release occurred |"},{"line":145,"text":""},{"line":146,"text":"For integrators, this host supports at most 64 retained distinct request records"},{"line":147,"text":"per owned epoch, including refusals, and one in-flight write. A busy or exhausted"},{"line":148,"text":"write budget produces an exact cancelled/no-submit result; there is no queue or"},{"line":149,"text":"automatic retry. An unknown or reconciliation-required outcome is not success or"},{"line":150,"text":"proof of no submission, and it prevents normal-end readiness. The application"},{"line":151,"text":"must preserve those records instead of treating panel cleanup as recovery."},{"line":152,"text":""},{"line":153,"text":"The ordinary panel does not poll diagnostics or claim that the whole run ended."},{"line":154,"text":"The protocol has no END message: business stop, node COMPLETE and run termination"},{"line":155,"text":"are distinct. Retention remains bounded by the existing contract, not by whether"},{"line":156,"text":"someone is viewing the graph. The demo's final forced test cleanup does not prove"},{"line":157,"text":"normal lifecycle completion."},{"line":158,"text":""},{"line":159,"text":"The private value binding clears stale values on INVALIDATE and ERROR. Start with the object supplied to your component:"},{"line":31,"text":""},{"line":32,"text":"| You already have | Read this contract first | Read implementation details when |"},{"line":33,"text":"|---|---|---|"},{"line":34,"text":"| An existing `SpendingAlertsView` and a render callback | [`mountSpendingView`](causal-view-binding.ts): five latest port values, explicit `unavailable` ports, observation cleanup | You need a different observation policy; the [ordinary panel](causal-ordinary-panel.ts) shows a consumer |"},{"line":35,"text":"| A Graph and prepared creation inputs | [`spendingAlertsFor`](causal-entry.ts): immutable defaults, per-compose overrides and returned view/capabilities | You also own input preparation or the executing host; follow [inputs](causal-inputs.ts) or [host](causal-focused-host.ts) for those responsibilities |"},{"line":36,"text":"| Issued capabilities, their owning Graph and expected binding | [`assertCausalCapabilities`](../../packages/ts/src/solutions/causal-occurrence/capabilities.ts): issued-object, Graph, binding and lineage validation | You implement capability construction; the [role examples](causal-audience.examples.ts) show consumption |"},{"line":37,"text":"| The owning Graph and a running instance | [Inspect one instance in a shared graph](#inspect-one-instance-in-a-shared-graph): full structure plus that instance's host and retained evidence | You are tracing a specific readiness, admission or outcome dependency |"},{"line":38,"text":""},{"line":39,"text":"Using an existing view does not require reconstructing its input facts, permission"},{"line":40,"text":"sources or host. Readiness and"},{"line":131,"text":"unknown outcomes have the meanings below; inspecting them does not invoke"},{"line":132,"text":"transport, close the instance or recover an outstanding obligation."},{"line":133,"text":""},{"line":134,"text":"## Interpret observations accurately"},{"line":135,"text":""},{"line":136,"text":"| Observation | Meaning |"},{"line":137,"text":"|---|---|"},{"line":138,"text":"| Missing value or ERROR/INVALIDATE | No current usable fact on that port; do not retain the old displayed value |"},{"line":139,"text":"| Startup says started | The instance started; it does not prove authorization, success or run completion |"},{"line":140,"text":"| Assessment flags a transaction | The business condition is met; evidence and permission are still required |"},{"line":141,"text":"| Publication says succeeded | That exact request reports success in the simulated writer; other obligations and coverage remain separate |"},{"line":142,"text":"| Coverage/issues | Facts for their associated scope; the five latest port values are not an atomic snapshot |"},{"line":143,"text":"| Panel detach | Observation stops; the running instance retains outstanding obligations |"},{"line":144,"text":"| Application `runEndReady` / `inspect().normalEndReady` | Current graph/host readiness conditions, not proof that lifecycle termination or resource release occurred |"},{"line":145,"text":""},{"line":146,"text":"For integrators, this host supports at most 64 retained distinct request records"},{"line":147,"text":"per owned epoch, including refusals, and one in-flight write. An unknown or reconciliation-required outcome is not success or"},{"line":150,"text":"proof of no submission, and it prevents normal-end readiness. The application"},{"line":151,"text":"must preserve those records instead of treating panel cleanup as recovery."},{"line":152,"text":""},{"line":153,"text":"The ordinary panel does not poll diagnostics or claim that the whole run ended."},{"line":154,"text":"The protocol has no END message: business stop, node COMPLETE and run termination"},{"line":155,"text":"are distinct. Retention remains bounded by the existing contract, not by whether"},{"line":156,"text":"someone is viewing the graph. The demo's final forced test cleanup does not prove"},{"line":157,"text":"normal lifecycle completion."},{"line":158,"text":""},{"line":159,"text":"The private value binding clears stale values on INVALIDATE and ERROR. Distinct instances use distinct names, input Nodes and"},{"line":86,"text":"resource bindings. A name is not an authorization token. Changing `name` does not"},{"line":87,"text":"clone input Nodes, create an independent resource or rewrite its binding; the"},{"line":88,"text":"application prepares and supplies those separately. Sharing immutable defaults"},{"line":89,"text":"does not imply sharing a running instance or its resource."},{"line":90,"text":""},{"line":91,"text":"Display components receive only the original `.view`; frameworks pass the original"},{"line":92,"text":"identity/execution/retained capabilities; maintainers inspect the same Graph."},{"line":93,"text":"Showing an identity subset does not remove lifecycle or retained-evidence nodes."},{"line":94,"text":"Capabilities have no arbitrary I/O execution method. The application keeps the"},{"line":95,"text":"original owner and diagnostics. Fixed wiring passes the intended instance's"},{"line":96,"text":"original references without introducing another identity registry."},{"line":97,"text":""},{"line":98,"text":"## Inspect one instance in a shared graph"},{"line":99,"text":""},{"line":100,"text":"Keep the owning Graph and the original composed instance together. Start with"},{"line":101,"text":"`graph.describe()` without an explain-path filter; inspect the intended instance"},{"line":102,"text":"through its own `inspect()`, view and capability references. The existing"},{"line":103,"text":"[demo's evidence navigation](causal-graded-demo.ts) joins each publication to that"},{"line":104,"text":"instance's retained request and outcome."},{"line":105,"text":""},{"line":106,"text":"For an existing `graph` and its composed `app`, the read-only observations are:"},{"line":107,"text":""},{"line":108,"text":"```ts"},{"line":109,"text":"const fullGraph = graph.describe();"},{"line":110,"text":"const host = app.inspect();"},{"line":111,"text":"const publication = app.view.publication.cache;"},{"line":112,"text":"const retainedQuiescence = app.capabilities.retained.retainedQuiescence.cache;"},{"line":113,"text":"const authorityId = publication?.authorityId;"},{"line":114,"text":"const authority = authorityId === undefined ? undefined : graph.find(authorityId);"},{"line":115,"text":"```"},{"line":116,"text":""},{"line":117,"text":"Keep `fullGraph` when passing this inspection onward; counts alone discard the"},{"line":118,"text":"nodes and edges needed to investigate it. In a graph containing several instances,"},{"line":119,"text":"do not select the first node ending in `/causal/authority`: it may belong to a"},{"line":120,"text":"different instance. Here the exact ID comes from this instance's publication."},{"line":121,"text":"Before that publication exists, this navigation has no authority ID; leave it"},{"line":122,"text":"unavailable rather than selecting another instance's node. Structural presence"},{"line":123,"text":"alone does not establish permission, current evidence or successful completion."},{"line":124,"text":""},{"line":125,"text":"The [host](causal-focused-host.ts) retains request/admission/outcome records and"},{"line":126,"text":"publishes outcome facts into the graph. Its diagnostics are therefore not the"},{"line":127,"text":"only place a result can appear: the [publication](causal-publication.ts) also"},{"line":128,"text":"projects graph-held evidence. Keep the request references when correlating these"},{"line":129,"text":"views. These separate reads are not an atomic graph-and-host snapshot, and a"},{"line":130,"text":"missing publication does not mean that no request was submitted. Readiness and"},{"line":131,"text":"unknown outcomes have the meanings below; inspecting them does not invoke"},{"line":132,"text":"transport, close the instance or recover an outstanding obligation."},{"line":133,"text":""},{"line":134,"text":"## Interpret observations accurately"},{"line":135,"text":""},{"line":136,"text":"| Observation | Meaning |"},{"line":137,"text":"|---|---|"},{"line":138,"text":"| Missing value or ERROR/INVALIDATE | No current usable fact on that port; do not retain the old displayed value |"},{"line":139,"text":"| Startup says started | The instance started; it does not prove authorization, success or run completion |"},{"line":140,"text":"| Assessment flags a transaction | The business condition is met; evidence and permission are still required |"},{"line":141,"text":"| Publication says succeeded | That exact request reports success in the simulated writer; other obligations and coverage remain separate |"},{"line":142,"text":"| Coverage/issues | Facts for their associated scope; the five latest port values are not an atomic snapshot |"},{"line":143,"text":"| Panel detach | Observation stops; the running instance retains outstanding obligations |"},{"line":144,"text":"| Application `runEndReady` / `inspect().normalEndReady` | Current graph/host readiness conditions, not proof that lifecycle termination or resource release occurred |"},{"line":145,"text":""},{"line":146,"text":"For integrators, this host supports at most 64 retained distinct request records"},{"line":147,"text":"per owned epoch, including refusals, and one in-flight write. A busy or exhausted"},{"line":148,"text":"write budget produces an exact cancelled/no-submit result; there is no queue or"},{"line":149,"text":"automatic retry. An unknown or reconciliation-required outcome is not success or"},{"line":150,"text":"proof of no submission, and it prevents normal-end readiness. The application"},{"line":151,"text":"must preserve those records instead of treating panel cleanup as recovery."},{"line":152,"text":""},{"line":153,"text":"The ordinary panel does not poll diagnostics or claim that the whole run ended."},{"line":154,"text":"The protocol has no END message: business stop, node COMPLETE and run termination"},{"line":155,"text":"are distinct. Retention remains bounded by the existing contract, not by whether"},{"line":156,"text":"someone is viewing the graph. The demo's final forced test cleanup does not prove"},{"line":157,"text":"normal lifecycle completion."},{"line":158,"text":""},{"line":159,"text":"The private value binding clears stale values on INVALIDATE and ERROR. The existing"},{"line":160,"text":"public `subscribeNodeValues` adapter currently ignores INVALIDATE, so it is not a"}],"nextLine":161}]

An unknown or reconciliation-required outcome is not success or"},{"line":150,"text":"proof of no submission, and it prevents normal-end readiness. The application"},{"line":151,"text":"must preserve those records instead of treating panel cleanup as recovery."},{"line":152,"text":""},{"line":153,"text":"The ordinary panel does not poll diagnostics or claim that the whole run ended."},{"line":154,"text":"The protocol has no END message: business stop, node COMPLETE and run termination"},{"line":155,"text":"are distinct. Start with the object supplied to your component:"},{"line":31,"text":""},{"line":32,"text":"| You already have | Read this contract first | Read implementation details when |"},{"line":33,"text":"|---|---|---|"},{"line":34,"text":"| An existing `SpendingAlertsView` and a render callback | [`mountSpendingView`](causal-view-binding.ts): five latest port values, explicit `unavailable` ports, observation cleanup | You need a different observation policy; the [ordinary panel](causal-ordinary-panel.ts) shows a consumer |"},{"line":35,"text":"| A Graph and prepared creation inputs | [`spendingAlertsFor`](causal-entry.ts): immutable defaults, per-compose overrides and returned view/capabilities | You also own input preparation or the executing host; follow [inputs](causal-inputs.ts) or [host](causal-focused-host.ts) for those responsibilities |"},{"line":36,"text":"| Issued capabilities, their owning Graph and expected binding | [`assertCausalCapabilities`](../../packages/ts/src/solutions/causal-occurrence/capabilities.ts): issued-object, Graph, binding and lineage validation | You implement capability construction; the [role examples](causal-audience.examples.ts) show consumption |"},{"line":37,"text":"| The owning Graph and a running instance | [Inspect one instance in a shared graph](#inspect-one-instance-in-a-shared-graph): full structure plus that instance's host and retained evidence | You are tracing a specific readiness, admission or outcome dependency |"},{"line":38,"text":""},{"line":39,"text":"Using an existing view does not require reconstructing its input facts, permission"},{"line":40,"text":"sources or host. Readiness and"},{"line":131,"text":"unknown outcomes have the meanings below; inspecting them does not invoke"},{"line":132,"text":"transport, close the instance or recover an outstanding obligation."},{"line":133,"text":""},{"line":134,"text":"## Interpret observations accurately"},{"line":135,"text":""},{"line":136,"text":"| Observation | Meaning |"},{"line":137,"text":"|---|---|"},{"line":138,"text":"| Missing value or ERROR/INVALIDATE | No current usable fact on that port; do not retain the old displayed value |"},{"line":139,"text":"| Startup says started | The instance started; it does not prove authorization, success or run completion |"},{"line":140,"text":"| Assessment flags a transaction | The business condition is met; evidence and permission are still required |"},{"line":141,"text":"| Publication says succeeded | That exact request reports success in the simulated writer; other obligations and coverage remain separate |"},{"line":142,"text":"| Coverage/issues | Facts for their associated scope; the five latest port values are not an atomic snapshot |"},{"line":143,"text":"| Panel detach | Observation stops; the running instance retains outstanding obligations |"},{"line":144,"text":"| Application `runEndReady` / `inspect().normalEndReady` | Current graph/host readiness conditions, not proof that lifecycle termination or resource release occurred |"},{"line":145,"text":""},{"line":146,"text":"For integrators, this host supports at most 64 retained distinct request records"},{"line":147,"text":"per owned epoch, including refusals, and one in-flight write. An unknown or reconciliation-required outcome is not success or"},{"line":150,"text":"proof of no submission, and it prevents normal-end readiness. The application"},{"line":151,"text":"must preserve those records instead of treating panel cleanup as recovery."},{"line":152,"text":""},{"line":153,"text":"The ordinary panel does not poll diagnostics or claim that the whole run ended."},{"line":154,"text":"The protocol has no END message: business stop, node COMPLETE and run termination"},{"line":155,"text":"are distinct. Retention remains bounded by the existing contract, not by whether"},{"line":156,"text":"someone is viewing the graph. The demo's final forced test cleanup does not prove"},{"line":157,"text":"normal lifecycle completion."},{"line":158,"text":""},{"line":159,"text":"The private value binding clears stale values on INVALIDATE and ERROR.
